explained.tdh.versions.site.title: {count} versions since {year}
explained.tdh.versions.site.body: Each version changed the boost: what a full set pays, and how many seasons can pay. The specification restates only the current one, TDH v1.4, and the daily comparison checks only that one.
explained.tdh.versions.name: TDH v{version}
explained.tdh.versions.note: Under TDH v1.4 the highest boost today is about {max}, with full sets, extra sets and {gradients} Gradients, and the rule's ceiling about {ceiling} once season {last} is complete. Today's values are computed by the TDH v1.4 engine on the editions read {date}.
explained.tdh.versions.chart.label: The full-set boost from seasons, version by version
explained.tdh.versions.chart.caption: Each step is one version: the full-set boost from seasons while it was in effect. Today's version is blue; the dashed line is its ceiling, reached once every season it names pays.
explained.tdh.versions.spec.label: In the specification
explained.tdh.versions.spec.title: One set of rules, renamed once
explained.tdh.versions.spec.body: P26 names the rules by a rule version that every result carries, and a new TDH version on 6529.io is a new rule version (D137).
explained.tdh.versions.spec.list: The rule versions of the specification
explained.tdh.versions.v14.body: The specification's name, from {date} (D137), for the rules 6529.io runs as TDH v1.4, with four-wallet consolidation (D136). Registry {registry}, rule ID {ruleId}. Frozen at launch; any later change is a new rule version.
